newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end higher in all months.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end higher in all months.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures closed higher in all months on Monday, reflecting the yen's falls against the dollar, traders said.
Prices were 0.7 to 1.7 yen per kg higher, with the benchmark May 1997 contract up 1.3 yen at 147.3.

All months gained from the opening, as local investors covered short positions, traders said. Traders said position adjustment at the spot month, which expires on December 20, also helped support nearby months.
"We were also encouraged by falling domestic rubber stocks," a brokerage house trader said.
